palette.notes: Host set is warm dark brown/black bookshelf blur, near-black (#0E0B08). Bold headline captions are white with black stroke; hero keywords recolor to lime-yellow (#D4FF3D) or lime-green (#7CFC8A) for emphasis (e.g. 'Max', 'unfair advantage', 'real products'). Insert cards use cream/khaki paper bg (#EDE8D0) with black monospace text for concept slides ('You write the code' / 'NVIDIA pays the compute bill'). One danger beat flashes a dark red overlay (#7A1414) over grayscale b-roll ('developers panicked'). Screenshots/UI captures keep native app colors (Anthropic black, NVIDIA dark UI, whale/Kimi logos) unaltered.

headline.family_guess: Inter/SF Pro Bold or similar grotesque sans
headline.size_rel: large, 2-4 words per card, centered mid-lower frame

caption.size_rel: medium, 1 short phrase, stacked 1-2 lines, centered lower-middle third over host chest

layout.host_pos: centered chest-up, static camera, seated, warm blurred bookshelf background, consistent framing entire video
layout.safe_zones: captions sit in lower-middle third (below chin, above bottom UI-safe margin); top third kept clear for platform chrome
layout.caption_pos: center-anchored, one phrase revealed per cut, word-level recolor for emphasis

transitions: logo sting cut (Anthropic wordmark, GLM/Kimi/whale logos)
